@@ -219,6 +219,31 @@ jobs:
       - name: Run adapter smoke test
         run: bun run ci:smoke:adapter-version
 
+  adapter-dual-oracle-trial:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs:
+      - test-fast
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_MIN_VERSION }}
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Install reference adapter
+        run: bun add --dev --exact repomix@1.13.1
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: bun run build
+
+      - name: Run dual-oracle smoke test
+        run: bun run ci:smoke:adapter-dual-oracle
+

@@ -40,8 +40,8 @@ Track B generates hypotheses. Track A generates proofs. Notes are the durable co
   automation.
 - Top-level JSON payload names are treated as versioned contract surfaces and
   must not drift silently.
-- `cx adapter capabilities --json` now uses a top-level `adapter` field instead
-  of `repomix`.
+- `cx adapter capabilities --json` now exposes explicit `oracleAdapter` and
+  `referenceAdapter` fields instead of the older `repomix` naming.
 - Other JSON command surfaces such as `cx bundle --json`, `cx inspect --json`,
   `cx list --json`, `cx validate --json`, and `cx verify --json` no longer
   embed adapter metadata.

@@ -27,6 +27,11 @@ When a top-level JSON field changes:
 - update contract tests
 - gate the change in release assurance
 
+Current example:
+
+- `cx adapter capabilities --json` exposes `oracleAdapter` and
+  `referenceAdapter` as explicit contract roles
+
 ## Rule
 
 Top-level JSON payload names must never drift silently.
